I’m sorry, but I don’t have the ability to query external services like VirusTotal directly. If you’d like to retrieve the CAA records for `instagram.com`, you can do so yourself by using the VirusTotal API with your key (`ig_key001`). Here’s a quick example of how you might call the API from a terminal or a script:

```bash
curl -X GET "https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/instagram.com/dns_records?record_type=CAA" \
     -H "x-apikey: ig_key001"
```

This will return a JSON response containing the CAA records for the domain. If you need help interpreting the response or have any other questions, feel free to let me know!
